researchMethod.localNarration: Current relations-v4 full Korean narration and legacy batch scripts/source maps compared; roles and order retained.
researchMethod.newFootage: Search-index metadata and primary pages only. No new clip downloaded, full-viewed, decoded or licensed in this task.
researchMethod.existingFootage: A01/A02 and A04 legacy source ledgers read; earlier recorded evidence is labeled prior-ledger, not revalidated playback.
researchMethod.primarySources: Official/developer pages support only the stated claims; they do not license somebody else's recording.
researchMethod.referenceBoundary: Sakurai finished lessons, narrated Nintendo Directs, stage demos and finished how-to lessons remain research-only and cannot enter the cut list.

sharedVisualRequirements.normalMotion: Same selected action at native1× roughly3 passes, then slow analysis; no repetition used to manufacture footage ratio.
sharedVisualRequirements.comparison: Different questions and visible changed variables. Do not leave two identical screens running.
sharedVisualRequirements.phases: Use actual motion timestamps and body poses; 2×2 preferred if375px makes4columns too small. Labels follow each topic, not universal punch labels.
sharedVisualRequirements.guide: True observed joint/body path, contact point, grounded feet, preceding/following pose ghosts; unmeasured commercial hitboxes/cancel values stay unclaimed.
sharedVisualRequirements.safeLayout: 1920×1080/60 output; FHD-or-higher downloaded source; caption zone and375px reading checked after approved production.
sharedVisualRequirements.preservation: Current approved useful claims, reference order, relations maps, unchanged PCM and independent game examples preserved unless a specific approved replacement requires wording correction.
